meta_description:
25K likes, 336 comments - thatbohogirl on September 23, 2026: "@elleindia fashion influencer of the year. we did it guys 🔥
i’m gonna be completely honest here. 12 years of consistently showing up, and somehow i’ve spent so much of that time being critical of myself instead of actually stopping and feeling proud. there was always that little voice asking, do i really belong here?

but looking back now, i realise i never really stopped. i kept learning, creating and rebuilding through all of it and maybe that consistency is the part of this journey i’m most proud of.

the last few years have been about owning my hard work, finding my confidence and learning that i’m allowed to take up space in the rooms i’ve worked so hard to be in.

here’s to breaking our own barriers, falling down, rebuilding ourselves and getting back up again. and to every woman still figuring it out along the way… this one’s for you too. 

forever grateful to you guys for growing with me through every version of me and letting me live dreams i once only imagined. we did this together and we’re just getting started. ❤️❤️🧿🧿".
